name: Snapmaker Artisan 40W
header: M2000 W1 P100 ; Artisan Setting to turn on Enclosure lights 100%
G0 F{feedrate} ; set default feedrate for laser off moves
G1 F{feedrate} ; set default feedrate for laser on moves
footer: M2000 W2 P0 ; Artisan Setting to turn off Enclosure fan (0%)
M2000 L23 P1 ; Artisan 40W laser. 1 exits half power Moade

constant: M3 P0 ; set laser to constant Mode
variable: M4 P0 ; set Laser to variable Mode

half: M2000 L23 P0 ; Artisan 40W laser. 0 enters half power Mode (20W max)
full: M2000 L23 P1 ; Artisan 40W laser. 1 exits half power Mode (40W max)

on: G4 S1.0 ; Wait for 1.0 seconds to allow air assist to stabilize

enclosure_fan: M2000 W2 P{fan} ; Artisan Enclosure fan to {fan}%
